proposed_rule: After BAS compilation, verify every task function argument against final_output all_input order, especially when static pointer/vector inputs and producer-output pointer dependencies are mixed. Reorder the source signature and BAS call together when the serialized ABI groups static inputs before dependencies.
proposed_linter_hint: Compare compiler-extracted input_type.json with the ordered final DAG all_input list and reject incompatible datatype or pointer positions before Gem5 execution.

symptoms: all-zero second-task outputs when config and dependency descriptors were bound to the wrong formal positions
page-table fault at 0x1000600 after dependency positions were corrected but a Venus pointer descriptor was CPU-dereferenced
evidence.resolution: match serialized input order and keep scalar accesses on vaddr(local_vector); use pointer descriptors only with Venus load/store operations

limitations: The exact grouping policy is a current toolchain behavior and should be encoded by compiler-generated bindings rather than assumed by future backends.
The pointer-address restriction needs a dedicated positive/negative conformance test before promotion to live knowledge.
